purpose: Deterministic offline regression suite for synthetic home-healthcare messages and recovery workflow behaviour.
limitations: All scenarios and records are synthetic.
The suite is small and authored for regression testing; it is not an independent holdout benchmark.
The LLM is disabled during this run so results measure the rules-first path and safe escalation, not live LLM quality.
A proposed recovery is not a real booking or proof of real-world operational impact.
